items.source: Note that Struts has a special requirement in that it parses web.xml to find its servlet mapping. Therefore, you need to specify the DispatcherServlet's servlet name as "servletName" on this controller, so that Struts finds the DispatcherServlet's mapping (thinking that it refers to the ActionServlet).
items.translation: 请注意，Struts 有一个特殊要求，即它会解析 `web.xml` 以查找其 servlet 映射。因此，您需要在该控制器中将 DispatcherServlet 的 servlet 名称指定为 "servletName"，以便 Struts 找到 DispatcherServlet 的映射（误以为它指的是 ActionServlet）。

items.source: Example: a DispatcherServlet XML context, forwarding "*.do" to the Struts ActionServlet wrapped by a ServletWrappingController. All such requests will go through the configured HandlerInterceptor chain (for example, an OpenSessionInViewInterceptor). From the Struts point of view, everything will work as usual.
items.translation: 示例：一个 DispatcherServlet XML 上下文，将 "*.do" 转发给由 ServletWrappingController 包装的 Struts ActionServlet。所有此类请求都将通过配置的 HandlerInterceptor 链（例如 OpenSessionInViewInterceptor）。从 Struts 的角度来看，一切都将按 usual 正常工作。

items.source:
Useful to invoke an existing servlet via Spring's dispatching infrastructure,
for example to apply Spring HandlerInterceptors to its requests.
items.translation: 通过 Spring 的分派基础设施调用现有的 servlet 很有用，例如对其请求应用 Spring HandlerInterceptors。

items.source: name - the name of the bean in the factory. Note that this name is the actual bean name used in the factory, which may differ from the originally specified name: in particular for inner bean names, the actual bean name might have been made unique through appending "#..." suffixes. Use the BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String) method to extract the original bean name (without suffix), if desired.
items.translation: name - 工厂中 Bean 的名称。请注意，此名称是工厂中实际使用的 Bean 名称，可能与最初指定的名称不同：特别是对于内部 Bean 名称，实际的 Bean 名称可能已通过追加"#..."后缀使其唯一化。如需提取原始 Bean 名称（不带后缀），请使用BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String)方法。
